item.title: Central bank holds benchmark rate at 6.25 per cent
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Ordelia kept its benchmark rate unchanged at 6.25 per cent on Friday, Governor Anaya Rao said, after consumer inflation eased to 4.1 per cent in August.

item.title: Cyclone Verath crosses coast, relief camps opened in three districts
item.description: Relief camps opened across three districts as Cyclone Verath crossed the coast. The state disaster authority said wind speeds reached 110 kmph.

item.title: Space agency sets December window for uncrewed test flight
item.description: The national space agency said the uncrewed test flight of its crew capsule will lift off in a window opening on 12 December from the Meritha range.
